description: Defines the abstract base class PdfAnnotation for PDF annotations, including properties for rectangle, title, subject, contents, color, opacity, and related metadata, along with initialization and deletion methods.

classes.name: PdfAnnotation
classes.description: Abstract base class for all PDF annotations, managing common properties and behaviors.

classes.name: Keys
classes.description: Contains key definitions for annotation dictionary entries, including type, subtype, rectangle, contents, color, opacity, and other metadata.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Sets default values for annotation type, name, and modification date.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Removes the annotation from its parent collection (obsolete, use Parent.Remove(this)).
